concept: Full pillar parity, VOICE-FIRST. The form-first Flutter app becomes a voice-first co-teacher: a nearly-empty ivory home with one large saffron seal mic (VIDYA), then the 6 pillars hung off that spine. Reuses The Ledger — Ivory & Ink design system; no new visual language.

navigation.home: Pillar 02 VIDYA voice canvas (one large seal mic) + Pillar 01 tool register below the fold
navigation.notes: Not a flat 6-tab bar. Create is absorbed into the mic (speaking is creating). Parent hotline (03) reached from Home/roster, not a tab.

units.title: Voice stack + permissions
units.notes: Injectable service abstractions (lib/shared/voice/, not the plan's lib/shared/media/voice_capture_controller+tts_player — the VAD/state-machine controller is U-V3): AudioRecorderService (record 5.2.1 -> WAV 16kHz mono, normalised 0..1 amplitude stream, start/stop -> Recording{path,byteLength}, cancel discards) + AudioPlayerService (just_audio 0.9.46 -> Base64Mp3Source in-memory playback, decodeBase64Mp3 degrades to silence, cancel-before-next-speak). All 4 plugins resolved with NO substitution: record 5.2.1, just_audio 0.9.46, permission_handler 11.4.0, audio_session 0.1.25. Added path_provider 2.1.6 as the recorder's writable-temp-path companion (Directory.systemTemp is not app-writable on Android) — not a substitute. Manifest: RECORD_AUDIO + microphone uses-feature + INTERNET (was missing from the release manifest). iOS Info.plist NOT touched (Android-first, no iOS target). 23 tests with fakes; no real mic/audio in CI. VOICE CANNOT BE EXERCISED LIVE (no device mic; routes 401) — verified by code + unit test only. Runtime mic-permission request UI (permission_handler at first tap + Open-settings recovery) lands with U-V4/U-V5 per HANDOFF.md §8.

units.notes: 5 repos over ApiClient + typed DTOs. Added ApiClient.postMultipart (STT) + mirrored it in FakeApiClient. Typed directive domain object U-V6 consumes: VidyaDirective{VidyaFlow flow, VidyaDirectiveParams params}; VidyaFlow is the closed enum guard (fromWire drops hallucinated flows -> no 404, mirrors web KNOWN_FLOWS); AssistantResponse.toDomain derives 0/1/2-3 guarded directives (plannedActions preferred, singular action fallback, capped 3). Verified contracts: STT multipart field `audio`+`expectedLanguage` -> {text,language}; TTS request field is `targetLang` (BCP-47), NOT `language` (task wrote it loosely); assistant uiLanguage wins over detectedLanguage; profile POST is strict {profile:{...}} envelope; session POST {sessionId,messages,actionTriggered?,screenPath?,isNew?}. 47 tests via FakeApiClient (golden decode + request-shape pinning + a 401/429 branch per repo), NO network. Live calls 401 on the stub token until Firebase auth — EXPECTED, handled, verified by code + unit test only.

units.title: VidyaController — state machine + conversation/session state + guards
units.notes: The single VIDYA brain: coupled capture+conversation state machine ported from the web (SPEC §A.6). VidyaStatus idle -> requestingPermission -> listening -> transcribing -> thinking -> speaking -> idle, plus dignified micDenied / signedOut (401) / limitReached (429) / failed (network) terminal states. Conversation is an ordered list of document blocks (teacher + VIDYA), never a chat thread; 0 directives = speak-only, 1 = pendingNavigation (home auto-routes), 2-3 = confirm chips (dispatchDirective routes one + drops its chip). Every await guarded by a generation counter (_stale) so cancel/fresh-tap abandons an in-flight trip. Ported guards: MIN_AUDIO_BYTES reject, transcription-refusal filter, fresh-classification window (5min+same path) for chatHistory, VAD auto-stop (trailing/initial silence + 30s cap), profile-poisoning guard (learns grade/subject, NEVER utterance language). LANG_TO_BCP47 + normaliseVidyaLanguage (mr->hi voice, or->en). New MicPermissionService seam (permission_handler) -> permanent-deny state. Session turn-sync + profile-learn fire-and-forget (401 on stub, swallowed). Added per-path POST stubs to FakeApiClient (additive; existing tests untouched). 19 pure-Dart machine tests with fake recorder/player/permission — verified by code+test only (no device mic; routes 401).

units.title: Seal Mic widget (5 states, breathing/listening/thinking/speaking, reduce-motion)
units.notes: The authored signature control (SPEC §B.2): a 128dp circular saffron wax-seal — brandSaffron face + a 2px brandBrass ring, an onPrimary Lucide mic glyph, lifted on the warm CTA glow — mirroring the splash Seal, NOT a Material FAB. Owns a small SealMicState enum (idle/listening/transcribing/thinking/speaking) so it is testable and reusable independently of the controller. Five calm motions, each gated on context.motionEnabled -> reduce-motion renders the composed still: idle 3s breathing scale + halo; listening concentric rings reacting to a passed 0..1 amplitude; transcribing/thinking a calm orbiting arc over a faint track (a full soft ring under reduce-motion); speaking a gentle expanding pulse. PressableScale on tap; a single button Semantics node with the state hint + a tap action; 128dp clears the 48dp floor. 19 widget tests: every state renders; reduce-motion collapses to a non-ticking static frame (pumpAndSettle returns); the four ambient states tick under motion while listening stays amplitude-driven; tap, semantics, tap-target, dark render. CRITICAL for later units: a continuous repeating controller means pumpAndSettle-based tests on any screen hosting it MUST disable animations (see U-V5).

units.title: VIDYA Home screen (Almanac Speaks) — replaces the form-first home
units.firebaseGated: partial (UI testable now; live conversation needs auth)
units.notes: The voice-first landing (SPEC §B): a nearly-empty warm-ivory page (paper gradient) with the Seal Mic at the optical centre (slightly high), a time-aware Fraunces greeting (reuses dashboardGreeting* keys), a saffron eyebrow/rule/deck, and a rotating prompt (timer only under motion). Turns ink as document blocks (ConversationBlockView: teacher AppCard(inset)+YOU-SAID overline, VIDYA AppCard+accentBar+tick, all AiText, inkSettle per new block via ListView.builder so only new blocks animate). Compound intents -> confirm chips (primaryContainer + 1.5px primary border + sparkles); single intent -> ref.listen routes to the flow's tool prefilled then consumeNavigation. Terminal states render dignified panels (signed-out has no CTA; mic-denied -> Open settings; failed -> Try again). ROUTER/IA: Home = VidyaHomeScreen in the shell (nav icon -> mic); the former dashboard tool-grid moved to Routes.prepDesk reached from the app-bar layoutGrid action + still in the Create palette. Fixed a latent app_shell bug: _AnimatedTabBody's lazy `late final` controller first-initialised inside dispose() under reduce-motion -> Ticker lookup on a deactivated element crashed 85 tests; now eager in initState. 24 ARB keys added across all 11 languages (never Hindi-only) + gen/** regenerated. 12 home widget tests + updated IA tests (splash/onboarding/login landing -> VidyaHomeScreen; pumpSignedInApp disables animations for the breathing Seal; pumpDashboard -> /prep-desk; library reaches the tab from the shell; shared-read test reframed) — tool reachability assertions kept intact. Verified by code+test only; the loop awaits Firebase auth.

units.title: Thread voice INTO tools (nav+prefill dispatcher + inline field mic)
units.notes: Threads VIDYA's NAVIGATE_AND_FILL directive INTO the tools. The VidyaFlow -> route+prefill dispatch is wired through app_router (the single intent path ref.listen'd from the voice home) so a spoken 'make a Class 5 fractions quiz' opens the right tool prefilled; instant_answer/lesson_plan/quiz_generator screens accept the prefilled seed + expose an inline field mic entry. Reuses the U-V3 controller + kToolRegistry; no new visual language. ARB keys added across 11 langs. Verified by code+test only (routes 401 on the stub until Firebase); analyze clean, suite green.

units.title: Persistence + presence (Firestore restore, turn sync, VIDYA on every screen)
units.firebaseGated: yes (live restore needs real auth; plumbing testable now)
units.notes: VIDYA persistence + on-every-screen. restoreSession() concurrently fetches latest session + profile (Future.wait) and rehydrates the conversation as ConversationBlocks on first open, guarding against a mid-fetch tap overwriting an inked block; degrades silently to a fresh empty session on 401; turn-sync + profile-learn remain fire-and-forget. VIDYA is reachable from ANY tool screen: a dignified sparkles app-bar action on ToolScaffold (48dp IconButton, tooltip=semantic label, not a Material FAB) opens vidya_sheet.dart — a bottom sheet bound to the SAME top-level VidyaController, so the conversation is continuous mid-tool; the home route listener guards on ModalRoute.isCurrent so home + sheet never double-dispatch an intent. Terminal/status panels extracted to shared vidya_status_ui.dart consumed by BOTH home and sheet (cannot drift). Design-review PASS (0 blockers) vs PREMIUM_DESIGN_SPEC §7. 11-lang ARB (never Hindi-only). +23 tests (persistence + sheet) -> 912 green, analyze 0, token_guard PASS. No native touched (no APK gate). Live restore/turn-sync verified by code+test only (401 on stub) until Firebase. NIT filed: conversation_block _ConfirmChip ~34dp tap target (pre-existing, now surfaced on every screen).

units.title: HotlineStage controller + poll discipline + resume
units.notes: HotlineStage machine (pickStudent->reason->compose->review->calling->summary) as a @riverpod keepAlive Notifier; terminal call outcomes modelled as DATA on the summary stage (HotlineSummaryOutcome {summary/manual/callFailed/endedNoConversation/summaryUnavailable}) so U-PH5 switches one enum. Ports the web poll discipline EXACTLY: first poll 3s then 5s interval (~60 ceiling); terminal-without-summary -> 3s (~8 waits) -> pollExhausted. Resume via latestForStudent on init (terminal+summary->summary; initiated->re-bind polling; else fresh). Cancellation = generation-counter + ref.onDispose + _disposed guard: every post-await write abandoned if disposed/superseded; no state after teardown, no timer outlives the screen; leaving 'calling' stops polling only (server call keeps running). Typed U-PH1 errors -> state facets (premium gate / no-phone / dedup countdown / unsupported-language->canAutoCall=false / call-failed+whatsapp); plain 401->signedOut (identity never faked). F9-001 upheld (no parentPhone anywhere). ADVERSARIAL CODE-REVIEW found + fixed 2 real blockers: (1) dedup leaked across a student switch on the keepAlive controller -> _clearDedup() on any student change + copyForWhatsApp un-gated from dedup (always-available, SPEC B.5.2); (2) the dispose test was hollow (synchronous fake) -> fake now gates a poll IN FLIGHT via a Completer so the test disposes mid-await, PROVING the guard is load-bearing; plus 1-turn calls now classify via hadConversation. Build+review by subagents; the fix subagent hit an API session limit AFTER applying+passing all fixes (only a stray verification comment remained, cleaned in the main loop). +18 tests -> 972 green, analyze 0, token_guard PASS. No native touched (no APK gate). Live routes 401 on stub until Firebase; verified code+test only. Public intent API for U-PH3: init/selectStudent/selectReason/updateNote/draftMessage/createAndCall/copyForWhatsApp/retryCall/callAgain/leaveCalling.

units.title: Stages 1-4: pick -> reason -> compose -> review (+ decision bar)
units.notes: Staged flow in one ToolScaffold driving the U-PH2 controller: pickStudent (roster rows, no-phone rows disabled + inline hint) -> reason (4 selectable AppCards, primaryContainer fill + 1.5px primary border + check glyph via onPrimaryContainer, not colour-only) -> compose (reason-aware EvidencePanel + note field + Draft) -> review (drafted msg via AiText + Regenerate + decision bar). Routed via Routes.parentHotline + a 'Parent hotline' tool tile (phone-call) in the shared registry. Decision bar is a STICKY e3 footer (Scaffold.bottomNavigationBar via a small screen-local _ToolFooterScaffold, review stage only) so CTAs never fall below the fold; Copy-for-WhatsApp always enabled, Call hidden when !canAutoCall (NoteBanner), dedup countdown disables Call not WhatsApp. Terminal: signed-out EmptyView (no faked identity), premium-gate panel, InlineError. F9-001: only a pre-masked last-4 (•••• {last4}) ever rendered, pinned by a no-full-number test. i18n: ALL 48 parentHotline strings translated into all 10 Indic languages (480 translations, matching the vidya pillar register; ICU plurals + {last4}/{time}/{language} preserved) — a Hindi teacher gets this screen in Hindi (interim-LLM, native review pending). Firebase-gated (roster + /api/performance 401): overridable roster provider degrades to signed-out EmptyView; verified code+test only. Adversarial DESIGN-REVIEW caught + fixed 2 blockers (untranslated Indic strings; non-sticky/e2 decision bar with a false e3 comment) + 1 nit (low-contrast check glyph). +40 tests -> 1019 green, analyze 0, token_guard PASS, overflow gates bn/ta/te/ml x light/dark @360dp x1.3. No native touched. FOLLOW-UP: promote a footer slot into the shared ToolScaffold (U-PH4/PH5 reuse the pattern) — chip filed.

units.title: Stage 5: calling — honest breathing waiting state (no fake progress bar)
units.firebaseGated: yes (live status needs a real call; UI testable now)
units.notes: The honest calling waiting state (SPEC B.1 stage 5). calling_stage.dart: a centered saffron haloed phone-call IconWell that BREATHES via Transform.scale (3000ms, reduce-motion -> static composed frame; the seal_mic idiom, no per-frame relayout), a display headline 'Calling {studentName}'s parent…', a muted status line driven by callStatus (initiated+0-turns -> Ringing… else Conversation in progress, wrapped in Semantics liveRegion for screen-reader announcement), a tabular '{count} exchanges' pill shown only when turnCount>1, and the 'you can leave this screen — the summary will be waiting' reassurance. HONEST WAITING (B.5.4): NO determinate/percentage progress bar or spinner-with-ETA — ambient breathe only; pinned by a test asserting no Linear/CircularProgressIndicator. RESUMABILITY (B.5.5): PopScope -> leaveCalling() stops polling ONLY, never cancels the server call; re-open resumes via latestForStudent. Adversarial DESIGN-REVIEW caught the exchanges-pill count failing AA (onSurfaceVariant 3.86:1) -> fixed to full-ink onSurface (14.6:1); also fixed halo perf (width/height relayout -> Transform.scale) + added the status liveRegion. NOTE: the app-wide muted role (onSurfaceVariant #65758B on bg #F9F7F3 = 4.39:1, a hair under AA) is left AS-IS = exact production parity (sampled live), flagged to the founder as a production-vs-AA decision, not silently changed. i18n: 5 new strings in all 10 Indic languages (never Hindi-only; interim-LLM, native review pending). Firebase-gated (401 on stub) — verified by code+widget-test only. +19 tests -> 1038 green, analyze 0, token_guard PASS. No native touched.

guardrails: flutter build apk --debug MUST succeed — the Android build is a REQUIRED acceptance gate (scripts/verify_build.sh). analyze + test are NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT: they run the analysis server + test VM and NEVER compile the release kernel snapshot or invoke Gradle, so a stale federated plugin sibling (this is exactly how record 5.2.1 -> record_linux 0.7.2 vs record_platform_interface 1.6.0 broke the build while analyze+test stayed GREEN) or a minSdk/AGP/manifest-merge/desugaring break passes them and still fails the APK. Run scripts/verify_build.sh before landing ANY unit that touches pubspec.yaml/pubspec.lock, android/**, or ios/**. Do NOT wire the slow APK build into every unit's inner loop — it is the final gate for native-touching units only.
